name: Pending Reason 39 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction has a pending status.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Instruction was received after the account servicer's deadline. It will be managed as per the bilateral service agreement between the account servicer and account owner.

CYCL.name: Awaiting Next Settlement Cycle
CYCL.definition: Your instruction is confirmed in the local market or is ready for settlement, awaiting next settlement cycle.

FUTU.name: Awaiting Settlement Date
FUTU.definition: Awaiting settlement date. No settlement problems to be reported.

BOTH.name: Both Instructions On Hold
BOTH.definition: Counterparty's instruction and your instruction are on hold/frozen/ in a preadvice mode.

PRCY.name: Counterparty Instruction On Hold
PRCY.definition: Counterparty's instruction is a preadvice, that is, for matching only.

CLAC.name: Counterparty Insufficient Securities
CLAC.definition: Insufficient deliverable financial instruments in counterparty's account or counterparty does not hold financial instruments.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient financial instruments in your account.

LATE.name: Market Deadline Missed
LATE.definition: Instruction was received after market deadline.

LINK.name: Pending Linked Instruction
LINK.definition: Your instruction is pending settlement because the instruction linked to it is pending.

PREA.name: Your Instruction On Hold
PREA.definition: Your instruction is a preadvice, that is, for matching only.
